messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're scheduling a minimal-attack-surface base image cutover next Tue 09:00 PT. Need RBAC changes and KMS signer details. Who's on call for signing and audit checks?

oliver: I can own RBAC perms. Questions: which service accounts need cosign push perms? registry service acct vs build runner?

sandeep: We should limit to registry-deployer and signer-sa only. Also add keystore-read for canary pipelines, no write for builders.

sec-bot: Audit ticket created INFSEC-421; retention set to 14d for this cutover. Logs will stream to cloud-logs/infra-audit.

emma: KMS question — do we use envelope encryption or sign-only? If we use KMS-based keys for cosign, we'll need key rotation window and grant for cosign agent.

maria: Plan is sign-only via KMS -> cosign with KMS-backed key. Keystore policy: grant roles/cloudkms.signer to signer-sa only. Builders do NOT get signer permission.

oliver: For RBAC change I'll open a PR to iam-configs repo. Anyone want to review before EOD Fri?

sandeep: Also flagged vuln: CVE-2026-1234 in libc present in current baseimage. We'll backport fix into new base and run canary. Need to update vulnerability notes and escalations.

maria: Ops note: keep old tags available for rollback. We'll run runtime probes during canary to detect unexpected setuid, outbound connections, and unusual capabilities.

devops: Deploy bot queued preflight -> job id 8792. Preflight steps: build slim image, sign with cosign, push to staging, run attest + smoke. Command we use: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/cosign-key`

emma: Ensure audit logs capture both `cosign sign/verify` and KMS key use. Add KMS key access alert to PagerDuty-oncall.

oliver: PR opened: iam-configs#482. Proposed roles: signer-sa -> cryptoSigner on specific key, registry-deployer -> storage.objectAdmin scoped to staging bucket, auditors -> logging.viewer. Tagging @maria @sandeep for review.

maria: Quick pre-cutover checklist: 1) RBAC PR merged 2) KMS key IAM set 3) cosign test pass 4) audit pipeline wired to infra-audit 5) canary pass. I'll do final go/no-go at 08:30 Tue.

sandeep: I'll monitor vuln dashboard and run additional syscall fuzz against the canary. If syscall anomalies spike, I'll call abort.

emma: :thumbsup: Added KMS rotation doc link: https://internal.docs/kms-rotation. Note: HSM staging not available yet — rotation is manual for this key.

sec-bot: Policy enforcement note: `deny-privileged-containers` will be active on cutover clusters. File exception requests via INFSEC-423 if any workloads need temporary allowlist.

maria: OK — unless any objections I'll merge RBAC changes at 17:00 today and kick the preflight. @oliver please post rollback steps in the PR (image tag to revert + registry-cleanup checklist).

oliver: Will do, will also include a runbook snippet for oncall:
```
rollback steps:
1) set service to old-image:sha
2) trigger orchestrator rollback
3) revoke new-image tags if push was accidental
4) notify #incidents and engage sec oncall
```

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll update the cutover calendar and link the PR. Ping here if preflight fails or if we need an emergency freeze.
